subject: Transportation Systems
title: Shinkansen and City Growth
description: Learn Shinkansen and City Growth in one minute.

hook.text: When a Shinkansen station opens in a small city, population and land values rise within a decade.

buildup.text: The line between Tokyo and Osaka turned intermediate cities like Nagoya into economic powerhouses.

discovery.text: Japan calls this effect 'Shinkansen urbanization'—high-speed rail reshapes where people choose to live.

twist.text: Some analysts argue it just concentrates growth in cities on the line while draining those without it.

climax.text: The Shinkansen didn't just connect cities. It determined which ones grew and which ones shrank.

punchline.text: A train station can make or break a city's future.

quiz.question: What is 'Shinkansen urbanization'?
options: Cities growing because of their high-speed rail connection
